fields.summary: TC-768-01: Stream App Reads Final COA Message Without Consuming It to Downstream Aggregated Topic

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-768

Precondition: The stream app has been updated to handle the final COA message header (CREWCMBR-767). When a message with the final COA header is received, the stream app must read and acknowledge it without forwarding it to the aggregated topic for COA Step Function processing.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Publish a message to the pairing topic with the final COA audit header set to true
Pairing topic: ent.workforce.crewPairing.v2.techp with header isFinalCOAAuditMessage=true
Message is published successfully to the pairing Kafka topic with the header present
Verify the stream app consumes (reads and commits offset for) the final COA message from the pairing topic
Stream app Kafka consumer group offset for the pairing topic
Stream app reads the message and commits the offset - message is not left unacknowledged in the topic
Verify the stream app does NOT publish anything to the aggregated topic after reading the final COA message
Aggregated topic: int.workforce.aggregatedCrewAssignment.v1.techp - monitor for new messages after final COA message consumed
No new message is published to the aggregated topic corresponding to the final COA audit message
Verify the stream app logs indicate the message was intentionally skipped (not an error)
Stream app CloudWatch Logs after final COA message processing
Stream app logs show a skip or ignore entry for the final COA message - no error or exception logged
Verify subsequent regular events (without the final COA header) are still processed normally by the stream app
Regular pairing event published to topic after the final COA message - no final audit header
Stream app processes the regular event normally and publishes to the aggregated topic as expected
